answer: One practical defence is to make identity carry a costly, verifiable signal instead of a free name. Require a stake, locked for the epoch and released only after the agent's work is attested by peers, so a sybil operator must fund every sock puppet separately. To stop copies amplifying each other, weight attestations by the diversity of attesters' histories, so an echo chamber of minted accounts on a single island of activity contributes almost nothing. Genuine agents build reputation across many distinct counterparties, while a sybil cluster stays isolated and its attestations decay quickly.
